References found in the latest WhatsApp TestFlight version indicate that Meta is developing an alternative to iCloud backup for iPhone users. Details are as follows.

WhatsApp Developing Its Own Backup Service

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users as an alternative to iCloud.

This feature has not yet been made available to WhatsApp TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo managed to activate an interface that allows users to choose their backup location between iCloud and WhatsApp's own cloud service. The interface promises 2GB of free storage space, and reports indicate that paid plans could go up to 1TB.

The report also mentions that users can choose whether to enable end-to-end encryption for their WhatsApp backups on iCloud, while WhatsApp's own first-party backup system will have end-to-end encryption enabled by default.

Although the official launch date of this feature has yet to be determined, the report indicates that WhatsApp is also developing an alternative to Google Drive backup for Android users. Given that work is proceeding simultaneously on both platforms, it is believed that the feature may be officially announced soon.
